definition: A machine that produces an alternating e.m.f. by turning a coil in a magnetic field (with slip rings and brushes to connect it) or by turning a magnet beside a fixed coil.

Two metal rings on the axle of a rotating coil, one joined to each end of the coil, that turn with it while fixed brushes press on them, keeping the coil connected to the outside circuit without the wires twisting.
